text:
sara.infosec: quick alert from secret-scanner: we found several OAuth/service credentials in DoerTask webhook payloads stored in glacier-archive. Need immediate containment.

nina-sre: how many creds and where exactly?

sara.infosec: scanner found 5 tokens in /archives/glacier/2026/03/task-logs/taskflow-*.log and 2 in a delivery debug bundle. Pattern: `red_svc_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30}`. No external traffic observed yet but vendor integrations could have seen them.

quentin-platform: which services? owners?

sara.infosec: owners: notification-proxy (1), model-scheduler (2), metrics-export (1), billing-ingest (1), ui-ci (2). I'll DM owners now.

ashley.custops: do we notify customers?

omar-legal: hold on customer comms until we confirm exposure scope. Legal wants vendor timeline first. I'll loop in vendor counsel if needed.

quentin-platform: immediate containment steps I propose:
- disable DoerTask integration via feature-flag (prod + staging)
- revoke long-lived tokens and rotate service principals for affected services
- schedule a 20m debug window if infra needs to re-enable for verification
- purge archived logs containing tokens and replace with redacted copies

sara.infosec: agreed. Marking high priority. Also create incident SEC-2026-182.

devops-bot: [alert] secret-scanner v3.8: high-confidence secret matches in DoerTask payloads  ticket SEC-2026-182 created.

quentin-platform: I toggled feature-flag: `feature.toggle --set doertask=false --env prod,staging` (done). Dev sandbox still enabled for debugging.

nina-sre: can infra run a grep across glacier manifests to enumerate any other occurrences? I'll help with purge once we have list.

sara.infosec: action owners:
- nina-sre -> full archive grep + create purge plan (60m)
- quentin-platform -> block connector + coord rotations (2h)
- ashley.custops -> draft stakeholder comms templates (standby)
- omar-legal -> vendor notice and contract review (ASAP)

quentin-platform: search kickoff: `aws glacier select-job --vault-name redwood-archives --expression "SELECT * FROM archive WHERE archive like '%doertask%'"` then `zgrep -E "red_svc_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}"`

sara.infosec: note: prefer redact+replace instead of delete so auditors can still see we addressed it. Use `sensitive-redact` tool: `sensitive-redact --pattern 'red_svc_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}' --replace '<REDACTED-SVC>' --target s3://redwood-archives`

nina-sre: found 12 total matches across 3 archives; 2 correspond to long-lived keys (model-scheduler). Starting revocation for those now.

quentin-platform: rotation command for service principals: `curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL' -d 'service=model-scheduler'`  will coordinate canaries, do not rotate midnight jobs until we've verified failover.

ashley.custops: preparing internal and partner notice drafts. Will keep customer-facing on hold pending legal.

omar-legal: vendor (DoerTask) contacted via security@doertask.com and support escalation. They acknowledged and requested logs; legal asked for SLA for their remediation and confirmation of webhook scrub.

sara.infosec: request debug window: quentin, nina, please request a 30m window with justification in this thread.

quentin-platform: request: 30m debug window to re-enable DoerTask in staging for verification of redaction fix, time window 16:00-16:30 UTC. Reason: validate that scrubbed payloads do not contain tokens and integrations behave.

omar-legal: approved to proceed for staging only. Production needs CISO signoff after vendor confirms fix.

nina-sre: re-enabled in staging for 30m. All traffic logged to new w3c sink and sensitive fields masked by middleware. Observed no outbound pushes to unknown endpoints.

sara.infosec: rotation status?

quentin-platform: model-scheduler rotations complete. Billing-ingest rotated. ui-ci ephemeral tokens revoked and replaced. Notification-proxy scheduled next in 40m to avoid alert storms.

sara.infosec: purge plan: redact copies created and originals moved to `s3://redwood-archives/quarantined/SEC-2026-182/` with access limited to sec+legal for 90 days.

ashley.custops: drafting internal ops message: short note, what happened, owner actions, and next steps. Will post after legal review.

omar-legal: vendor requested proof of purge and confirmation of rotations; handing to phil in vendor-ops. Also drafted limited disclosure for customers if needed.

nina-sre: PR for ingestion scrub middleware opened: `https://git.internal/redwood/platform/PR-498`  matcher `red_svc_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}` and metric `ingest.redact.hits`. Requesting fast-track review.

quentin-platform: nightly archive-scan job scheduled for 7 days and alerting to #sec-automations.

sara.infosec: next steps:
- confirm production remain disabled until DoerTask confirms webhook payload sanitization OR we've added scrub at ingest (whichever later).
- postmortem (SEC-2026-182) assigned to quentin. Draft due EOD tomorrow.
- legal to review vendor SLA and next steps for remediation costs.

omar-legal: will follow up on contract language.

nina-sre: ingest scrub merged to main and deployed to staging. Will roll to prod after final review and load testing.

sara.infosec: thanks team. Add rotation evidence to SEC-2026-182 and mark whichever items are complete. We'll reconvene in 24h for closure decision. :lock:
